blocks.text: Hollywood star Patrick Stewart died in October from cardiopulmonary arrest and a neurocognitive disorder with Lewy body, according to his death certificate. Stewart’s cause of death was confirmed by foreign media outlet TMZ, which obtained the actor’s death certificate. The English actor’s demise was announced last Oct. 28 through an official statement released on social media. At the time, the statement noted that he died at his home in Los Angeles after a “brief and poignant journey” with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.
